
```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("tbl.PGA.TR")
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "PGA.TR.qmd",
  base = TRUE,
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
if (!exists("TR.target") || !length(TR.target)) TR.target <- TR.gmdp
if (!exists("Vs30.target") || !length(Vs30.target)) Vs30.target <- Vs30.gmdp
if (!exists("PSA_Units") || !length(PSA_Units)) PSA_Units <- "g"
root <- here::here()
```
